A 20-year-old man identified as Isa Mohammed has been arrested by the Bauchi State Police Command for allegedly stabbing to death another man identified as Salim Mohammed following a misunderstanding in the state. PUNCH Metro learnt on Tuesday that the suspect, a resident of Abujan Kwata, Bauchi, was arrested by the police operatives attached to the ‘A’ Division Township on Monday, a day after allegedly committing the crime. The police disclosed this in a statement issued on Tuesday by the command’s Police Public Relations Officer, Nafiu Habib. According to the statement, the suspect allegedly stabbed the victim to death on Sunday, October 18, following a disagreement. “The suspect allegedly stabbed one Salim Moh’d to death on 18th October, 2026, following a misunderstanding,” the statement read. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources The police spokesperson added that the suspect was trailed and arrested at about 1:20 pm on Monday. He said the suspect would be transferred to the State Criminal Investigation Department in Bauchi for further investigation and prosecution. The arrest was one of three operational breakthroughs recorded by the command within 24 hours, involving alleged armed robbery, culpable homicide and illicit drug trafficking. Police arrest three, recover pistol, ammunition in Jigawa Child trafficking suspect admits receiving ₦250,000 per child Police arrest three over armed robbery, murder in Bauchi In a separate incident, police arrested a 22-year-old man, Zakariya’u Musa, over the alleged robbery of three secondary school students along Old Airport Road in the Gidan Gona area of Bauchi. The police said the suspect and two accomplices allegedly threatened the students with a knife and dispossessed them of two mobile phones valued at N50,000. While Musa was arrested after the students raised the alarm, his alleged accomplices fled the scene. The command said efforts had been intensified to apprehend the fleeing suspects. In another operation, police arrested a 28-year-old woman, Sara Chikodi, at Bayan Gari, Bauchi, over alleged drug trafficking. The police said ten sachets of dry leaves suspected to be Colorado or Indian hemp and a pinch of methamphetamine, popularly known as ice, were recovered from her. The state Commissioner of Police, Sani-Omolori Aliyu, commended the officers for their prompt response and appreciated members of the public for providing timely information. He reaffirmed the command’s commitment to protecting lives and property, warning criminal elements to steer clear of the state.
